parent.name: Cardigans
parent.headline:
One more layer.
A little more you.
parent.description:
The soft knit. The easy throw-on.
The cardigan that brings it all together.
parent.advice: Button it over a simple tee. Drape it over a favourite dress. Leave it open with denim when the day slows down. A considered layer gives the pieces you already love a different feeling.
parent.detailLine: A stitch. A button. A different feeling.
parent.heroAlt: Campaign inspiration: a woman in an oatmeal cardigan and cream trousers beside a sunlit stone wall
parent.campaignNote: The parent campaign image is illustrative styling inspiration. Subcategory images and product cards use existing WOW Fashion product photography.

collections.name: Animal Print Cardigans
collections.headline:
A little wild.
Entirely you.
collections.description: One expressive print can change the whole outfit. Explore leopard layers with plenty of personality.
collections.advice: Keep the layers underneath simple: a plain tee, straight-leg denim and a favourite pair of boots. Pick out one colour from the print for your accessories.
collections.assignment: Editorial selection: Leopard Print Casual Kimono Cardigan. Retired leopard knit listing excluded.

collections.name: Cardigan Vests
collections.headline:
Another layer.
A different angle.
collections.description: Sleeveless shapes, easy movement and room to play. Find a cardigan vest that brings your outfit together.
collections.advice: Layer a sleeveless cardigan over a crisp shirt or close-fitting tee. A longer vest works with a straight trouser; a shorter shape pairs naturally with a higher waist.

collections.name: Cashmere Cardigans
collections.headline:
Softly layered.
Simply lovely.
collections.description: Wrap shapes and considered silhouettes from the cashmere edit. A gentle starting point for everyday dressing.
collections.advice: Try a wrap cardigan with tailored trousers, or a V-neck shape over a simple tee. Check each listing for its exact fibre composition and follow the garment’s care label.

collections.name: Cropped and Dressy Cardigans
collections.headline:
A shorter layer.
A lasting impression.
collections.description: A defined waist, an interesting button, a little evening possibility. Find the finishing touch in our cropped and dressy edit.
collections.advice: Try a cropped cardigan with a high-waisted skirt or wide-leg trousers. For an evening outfit, let the neckline and buttons be the detail and keep accessories simple.

collections.name: Kimono Cardigans
collections.headline:
Let it flow.
Make it yours.
collections.description: Open fronts, expressive patterns and an easy sweep of fabric. Discover kimono-style cardigans for relaxed layering.
collections.advice: Balance a flowing layer with a simple tank and a straight trouser. Leave the front open to show the outfit underneath, or try a slim belt for a little definition.

collections.name: Lace Cardigans
collections.headline:
Delicate details.
A different mood.
collections.description: Openwork textures and intricate patterns, from a light finishing layer to an expressive cover-up.
collections.advice: Wear lace over a plain camisole to bring out the pattern. Some styles are sheer cover-ups: check the product photographs and choose the coverage that suits your plans.

collections.name: Lightweight Cardigans
collections.headline:
Just enough.
Never too much.
collections.description: Fine layers and relaxed shapes for the moments between seasons. Find the cardigan you can keep close.
collections.advice: Start with a slim tee or sleeveless top and add an open cardigan. Choose a length that works with your waistline, and check the listing for fabric weight and composition.

collections.name: Long Cardigans
collections.headline:
Take the
long way.
collections.description: An easy sweep, a relaxed silhouette, a layer worth lingering in. Explore longer cardigans with everyday possibility.
collections.advice: A long open cardigan works well over a simple column of colour. Try straight-leg jeans or a narrow trouser, and leave the front open so the layers can move.

collections.name: Short Sleeved Cardigans
collections.headline:
A little sleeve.
A lighter feeling.
collections.description: Shorter sleeves and thoughtful textures. Discover an easy finishing layer for brighter days and indoor plans.
collections.advice: Try a short-sleeved cardigan over a plain tank, or layer a cropped shape over a dress. Keep the underlayer simple when the knit or trim has plenty of detail.

collections.name: Silk Cardigans
collections.headline:
A softer line.
A quieter statement.
collections.description: Delicate details and fluid-looking layers from our silk cardigan edit. Find a considered finishing touch.
collections.advice: Pair a long fine layer with a simple dress or a clean trouser shape. Silk-category listings can vary in composition; check the specific garment details before choosing.

collections.name: Summer and Spring Cardigans
collections.headline:
Longer days.
Lighter layers.
collections.description: Fresh patterns, open shapes and a warm-weather outlook. A cardigan for the breeze, the shade and the plans after sunset.
collections.advice: Try a light open layer over a simple tee and shorts, or a relaxed summer dress. Check opacity and fabric composition when choosing something for warmer days.

collections.name: Wool Cardigans
collections.headline:
Texture to love.
Layers to live in.
collections.description: From a fine knit to a more expressive stitch. Discover shapes and textures in the wool cardigan edit.
collections.advice: Balance a chunky-looking knit with smooth trousers or denim. For finer styles, add a shirt underneath. Check each listing for its exact wool content and care instructions.

collections.name: Hooded Cardigans
collections.headline:
Off-duty ease.
On your terms.
collections.description: A relaxed hood, a comfortable-looking shape and room for another layer. Discover cardigans for slower mornings and everyday plans.
collections.advice: Wear a hooded cardigan with a plain tee and straight-leg jeans. If you add an outer coat, leave enough room at the neck and shoulders for the hood to sit comfortably.

collections.name: Warm Cardigans
collections.headline:
Stay a little
longer.
collections.description: Textured knits and fuller layers for a cosy-looking outfit. Explore the shop’s warm cardigan selection.
collections.advice: Start with a comfortable base layer and choose a cardigan with room through the shoulders. Warmth depends on fibre content, knit and fit, so check the individual product details.

collections.name: Zipped Cardigans
collections.headline:
Zip up.
Step out.
collections.description: Clean closures and versatile shapes. Find a zipped cardigan that changes with your day.
collections.advice: Wear a zip cardigan open over a simple tee or zip it partway to frame the neckline. Pair a close-fitting shape with a relaxed trouser for an easy balance.
